name: Term Definition
job: Let a reader who does not know a word see its plain meaning in place, on hover, focus or tap, with a link to the full glossary entry.

anatomy.role: Inline `<button>` styled as text, dotted underline; solid and cyan when open
Below the term (above when there is no room), at most 280px and never wider than its container or the viewport
Bold term then one or two plain sentences, 0.9rem

states.name: Closed
states.note: Dotted underline only; the definition is already the button's description.

states.name: Open
states.note: Hover or focus shows it; a tap pins it until a tap elsewhere or Escape.

use_when: Client pages where a term of art (MVP, scope, discovery) would stop a non-technical reader.
Define it once per section; later uses can stay plain.
avoid_when: Do not put a definition on every repeat of a word, or on words a general reader knows.
Do not put actions other than the glossary link in the tip.

data.note: The word as it appears in the sentence.
The full glossary entry, such as `#glossary-mvp`.

access: The term is a `<button>` with `aria-describedby` pointing at the tip, so screen readers read the definition on focus even while it is hidden, and `aria-expanded` for its open state.
Escape closes the tip and keeps focus on the term; a tap pins it; a tap elsewhere closes it.
JS keeps the tip inside its container and the viewport, flipping it above when there is no room below.
Rem sizes; roomy spacing raises its line height to 1.8.

used_by.name: Approved My Ally Step 1 template (public/myally-hub.html, PR 2094)

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check` (in scripts): every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
Reading-options check: 375 and 1280, light and dark, largest text size, roomy spacing and the easy-read font.
